transcript:
Meeting header:
Date/Time: 2025-11-07 09:30 PT
Duration: 58 minutes
Attendees: Aisha Patel (IT Ops), Jon Meyers (Finance Ops), Priya Nair (Security/Compliance), Samir Rao (Infra Eng), Lena Ortiz (Legal), Marco Li (Procurement)

Summary (auto): quick sync to reconcile upcoming SOC2 evidence needs, SSO rollout timing (Okta), and cloud billing tag gaps for Q4 chargeback. Agreed to follow up with artifacts.

[00:00] Aisha: Morning everyone, thanks for jumping on. Uh we wanted to get finance and security aligned before we lock in the SSO changes and the private deployment pilot scheduling. So, quick rundown — agenda is SSO, billing/tagging, SOC2 evidence timeline, and any procurement blockers.

[00:18] Jon: Morning. Quick note — finance saw a spike in gpu-reserved costs last week, and some of the tag values are missing so it's hard to map to product teams. We'll show a sample later.

[00:32] Priya: Hi — from security, SOC 2 intake asked for user provisioning docs and proof of KMS usage for key management. We also need audit logs retention confirmation. So SSO is high-priority.

[00:45] Samir: Hey — infra's ready to test the private cluster, but we need clear KMS/HSM key rotation steps and the V P C peering checklist. Also, the firewall rules for the pilot need review — earlier change opened a port 22 temporarily and that caused jitter in the monitoring alerts.

[00:58] Marco: Procurement here — any contract changes for Dedicated or Private might need PO amendments; timeline matters for committing to reserved capacity because of vendor lead times.

[01:12] Aisha: Cool. Okta SSO: we did a quick spike with the dev org. Got the SAML metadata, but we still need to finalize attribute mapping (email vs mail vs userPrincipalName), and decide whether to use SCIM for provisioning or just SAML with JIT. Priya, do you have a preference?

[01:28] Priya: SCIM is preferred for auditability — auto-provisioning reduces manual deprovs which is usually a finding in audits. However, need to ensure SCIM uses the org KMS for secrets and tokens. Also the SCIM token lifecycle needs to be rotated and stored in our HSM.

[01:44] Lena: Legal side — if we enable SCIM we should confirm the data minimization policy. We don't want to pull more attributes than necessary. Also, contracting language around Okta vendor subprocessors — we should check existing addendum.

[01:59] Jon: On billing, the missing tag issue: examples show 18% of GPU spend missing team tag. Suspect it's because some batch jobs launched from legacy pipeline not passing --tags. Chargebacks rely on that. Should we put a blocking policy in place? like deny create without tag at the IAM level?

[02:18] Samir: We can do a policy guardrail, but need to be careful to not break automated builds. Maybe start with enforcement in org-level policy in the test accounts, and a soft alert in prod for two weeks.

[02:34] Aisha: That sounds sensible. Jon — can you provide the list of affected accounts and sample instances? We'll map to infra owners and schedule the test enforcement window.

[02:46] Jon: Yep I'll send that today. Also want to explore using reserved capacity pooling across teams to lower unit cost. If we commit to a Dedicated pool we need procurement timeline. Marco — what lead time are we looking at?

[03:02] Marco: Depends on provider — for dedicated GPU capacity the lead time ranges from immediate for cloud reserved sku to 3-4 weeks for some third-party dedicated offerings if they require hardware allocation. We need contract approval and PO.

[03:20] Priya: Back to SOC2: evidence for encryption at rest — we use KMS for managed keys in hosted, but for Private/on-prem we have customer-managed keys. Need a narrative describing key usage and screenshots of key policy. Also we need to confirm whether KV cache logs are included in audit logging — there's some ambiguity.

[03:40] Samir: The KV cache reference — infra has the telemetry, but it's routed to a different bucket and lifecycle. I think the transcripts from earlier calls said "K V cache" and sometimes spelled as K-V cache in docs, which confused the auditor. We'll unify wording.

[03:54] Aisha: Good call. Lena, can you add a glossary note for internal docs to reconcile terms (KV cache, model cache, prefix cache).

[04:06] Lena: Yep I'll add it.

[04:12] Priya: For logs retention — what's current retention for request traces and auth logs?

[04:20] Samir: Default is 90 days for request traces, 1 year for auth logs, though some dev buckets are shorter (30 days). We can extend to 13 months for the SOC2 window but there's cost impact.

[04:36] Jon: Finance prefers to cap retention where possible, but we can budget incremental spend if it's required. Need exact numbers to approve.

[04:46] Aisha: Action item — Jon will get an estimate of incremental storage cost for 13 months vs current.

[04:52] Jon: Yup, will do.

[05:01] Priya: Another ask — we should tighten SAML assertion lifetimes and MFA enforcement for admin roles. Are we planning to enable conditional access for VPN and private deploys?

[05:12] Samir: We're testing conditional access; one blocker is older agent versions in ops that don't support modern auth flows. Need a rollout plan to update agents.

[05:24] Marco: Procurement — if we require all vendors to approve modern auth, our supplier onboarding could be delayed. Need to send procurement a vendor impact checklist.

[05:36] Aisha: Ok noted. I'll coordinate with procurement.

[05:42] Priya: Evidence for encryption in transit — need TLS/MTLS config examples for private installs. Samir, can you attach the ca bundle example and firewall policy?

[05:53] Samir: Yes, I'll paste the CA config and sample iptables rules. Also note, during the last private pilot we used mutual TLS but the client cert rotation was manual; we should automate cert rotation in a later phase.

[06:10] Jon: Quick procurement question — for cost coding, can we accept multiple cost centers on one PO, or do you want separate POs per product?

[06:20] Marco: We prefer single PO with internal line items mapped to cost centers, but some vendors require a single accounting code. We'll handle with internal allocations.

[06:28] Aisha: Let's get back to timeline: SSO spike finished, SCIM decision leaning yes, we'll scope pilot for Private deployment in late Nov. SOC2 evidence prep aiming to close by end of Nov for readiness. Procurement to pull PO drafts this week.

[06:44] Priya: I just want to call out potential audit finding: missing SCIM token rotation policy. If we don't have rotation automated we should have manual rotation procedures documented as mitigations.

[06:56] Samir: Agree. I'll add a playbook entry for manual rotation plus a Jira to automate it.

[07:07] Aisha: Great. Any blockers from legal?

[07:10] Lena: Just double-checking the Okta DPA and subprocessors — I'll review and flag any necessary addenda. Also will add the glossary item.

[07:20] Marco: Procurement will start PO templates and confirm vendor lead times, I'll send to Jon and Aisha.

[07:27] Jon: I'll send the billing tag list and sample invoices. Also will model the cost delta for 13 month log retention and reserved capacity pooling.

[07:38] Priya: I'll schedule the SOC 2 tabletop and send the draft evidence map.

[07:43] Aisha: Perfect. Let's recap next steps.

[07:48] Aisha: Recap: Aisha — SSO integration proposal and diagram by Nov 14; Jon — tagged billing export and cost delta by Nov 10; Samir — VPC/firerule inventory and CA bundle examples by Nov 12; Priya — SOC2 tabletop invite and evidence map by Nov 20; Lena — legal review of Okta addendum and glossary update by Nov 13; Marco — PO template and vendor lead times this week.

[08:13] Marco: Sounds right.

[08:16] Jon: One last thing — can we add a short shared spreadsheet for owners and statuses? That will make approvals faster.

[08:24] Aisha: I'll create the sheet and share with the list after the call.

[08:30] Priya: Thanks everyone.

[08:33] Aisha: Thanks — meeting adjourned.

Notes: transcription includes minor mishears ("V P C" for VPC, "K V cache" for KV cache). References to dedicated capacity and reserved pools are internal planning, not finalized. Attachments referenced: Okta SAML metadata (link to internal drive), sample billing export (will be shared by Jon), CA bundle snippet (to be attached by Samir).
